AirFlowModeEnumeration.description: Determines the air flow, either from a fan or from compressed air.

OPTIMIZED.description: Energy optimized mode (depending e.g. on throughput / humidity…)

FRESH_AIR.description: The dryer is working with fresh air

RETURN_AIR.description: The dryer is working with return air, closed loop

DryingLevelEnumeration.description: Indicates how much drying is required.

LOW.description: The granulate requires a low level drying.

MEDIUM.description: The granulate requires a medium level drying.

HIGH.description: The granulate requires a high level drying.

DryingModeEnumeration.description: The drying mode determines the drying process.

BATCH.description: The granulate in the dryer is dried for a certain period of time and then switched to drying protection.

CONTINUOUS.description: The granulate in the dryer is dried continuously.

COMBINED.description: The very wet granulate in the dryer is dried for a certain period of time, after which it is dried continuously.

FunctionStatusEnumeration.description: Provides information about the current operation state of a function.

REQUESTED_ON.description: Function is switched off AND requested to be switched on by the client

ActivateAllFeeders.description: Method to activate all feeders at once.

ActivateDryingProtection.description: Method to activate the drying protection.

ActivateMaterialFeederDryer.description: Method to activate the material feeder of the dryer.

ActivateMaterialFeederMachine.description: Method to activate the material feeder of the machine.

ActivateTemperatureController.description: Method to request the activation of the temperature controller of the bin.

DeactivateAllFeeders.description: Method to deactivate all feeders at once.

DeactivateDryingProtection.description: Method to deactivate the drying protection.

DeactivateDryingProtectionAirVolumeFlowR.description: Request to deactivate the use of reduced air flow during drying protection or storage reduction.

DeactivateMaterialFeederDryer.description: Method to deactivate the material feeder of the dryer.

DeactivateMaterialFeederMachine.description: Method to deactivate the material feeder of the machine.

DeactivateTemperatureController.description: Method to request the deactivation of the temperature controller of the bin.
